name: Security Management Process
description: Implement policies to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and risk register confirm a security management process is in place.

partial_if.detail: Partial evidence of security management process.

missing_if.detail: No governance or risk data to verify security management.

remediation: Establish a formal security management process including risk analysis and sanction policies.

name: Workforce Security
description: Ensure workforce members have appropriate access to ePHI.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records confirm workforce access is tracked.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but access tracking is incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No employee records to verify workforce security.

remediation: Implement workforce authorization procedures. Track employee access levels.

name: Security Awareness and Training
description: Implement a security awareness programme for all workforce members.

compliant_if.detail: Employee training records confirm security awareness programme.

partial_if.detail: Employees exist but training records are incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No employee records to verify training.

remediation: Implement HIPAA-specific security awareness training for all workforce members.

name: Security Incident Procedures
description: Implement procedures to identify, respond to, and report security incidents.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm incident response procedures exist.

partial_if.detail: Risk register exists but no formal incident procedures.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of incident response procedures.

remediation: Develop incident response procedures covering ePHI breach identification and notification.

name: Contingency Plan
description: Establish a contingency plan for emergencies affecting ePHI systems.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and risk data confirm contingency planning.

remediation: Develop a contingency plan with backup, disaster recovery, and emergency procedures.

name: Business Associate Contracts
description: Ensure BAAs exist for all vendors handling ePHI.

compliant_if.detail: Vendor records confirm BAA tracking is in place.

partial_if.detail: Vendors tracked but compliance status incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No vendor records to verify BAA compliance.

remediation: Execute Business Associate Agreements with all vendors handling ePHI.

name: Facility Access Controls
description: Control physical access to facilities housing ePHI systems.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory confirms physical facility tracking.

partial_if.detail: Assets tracked but facility ownership incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory to verify facility access controls.

remediation: Implement facility access controls and visitor management.

name: Device and Media Controls
description: Implement policies for hardware and electronic media lifecycle.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and governance records confirm media management.

partial_if.detail: Assets tracked but media management not formally documented.

missing_if.detail: No asset records to verify media controls.

remediation: Implement media disposal and device re-use policies.

name: Access Control
description: Implement technical access controls to restrict access to ePHI.

compliant_if.detail: Employee access levels and network rules confirm technical access controls.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of technical access controls.

remediation: Implement unique user IDs, emergency access, automatic logoff, and encryption.

name: Audit Controls
description: Implement audit logging for ePHI system activity.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm audit logging processes.

partial_if.detail: Governance exists but audit review not formally tracked.

remediation: Enable audit logging on all ePHI systems and implement log review.

name: Transmission Security
description: Protect ePHI transmitted over electronic networks.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules confirm transmission security controls.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but deny rules incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No network rules to verify transmission security.

remediation: Implement TLS/SSL encryption for all ePHI in transit.
